title: Coloured bin lids (South Jutland)
description: Waste bins vary by area in Denmark. Bins with green, purple and yellow lids are found in southern Jutland, roughly south of a line from Blåvand to Brande and Vejle and west of the Little Belt, down to the German border.

title: Letter tubes (Jutland)
description: Tube-shaped mailboxes mounted on a post are typical of Jutland and help tell it apart from the Danish islands.
